rows.label: fev04_260_125_msg0001
rows.name:
So... how are we going to track down
Kiku?

rows.label: fev04_260_125_msg0002
rows.name:
We can't just ask around town
like we usually do...

rows.label: fev04_260_125_msg0003
rows.name:
Yeah... It was nighttime, so there
probably weren't many witnesses.

rows.label: fev04_260_125_msg0004
rows.name:
Heh heh heh... Looks like it's
Tora's turn, mo.

rows.label: fev04_260_125_msg0005
rows.name: Got something in mind, Tora?

rows.label: fev04_260_125_msg0006
rows.name: Dad probably finished Kiku, mo.

rows.label: fev04_260_125_msg0007
rows.name:
Yes, you already told
us that last night.

rows.label: fev04_260_125_msg0008
rows.name:
And as I said before, Hana was built
from the blueprints Dad entrusted
to me, mo.

rows.label: fev04_260_125_msg0009
rows.name:
So Kiku and Hana's designs are almost
exactly the same, mo.

rows.label: fev04_260_125_msg0010
rows.name:
Which means... The materials
required to construct both
would be quite similar?

rows.label: fev04_260_125_msg0011
rows.name: Exactly, mo!

rows.label: fev04_260_125_msg0012
rows.name: I see...

rows.label: fev04_260_125_msg0013
rows.name:
So if we trace where those materials
are going in Superbia, we might find
whoever built Kiku.

rows.label: fev04_260_125_msg0014
rows.name:
Master, that's your best idea
in ages, mo!

rows.label: fev04_260_125_msg0015
rows.name:
So Tora, what materials
exactly would someone need
to build an artificial Blade?

rows.label: fev04_260_125_msg0016
rows.name:
Let's see... An ether furnace
is obviously essential, but
besides that, we'd also need...

rows.label: fev04_260_125_msg0017
rows.name: Tetra-Circle!

rows.label: fev04_260_125_msg0018
rows.name: Snake Joint!

rows.label: fev04_260_125_msg0019
rows.name: Black Ash!

rows.label: fev04_260_125_msg0020
rows.name: Delta Box!

rows.label: fev04_260_125_msg0021
rows.name: Rabbit Diode!

rows.label: fev04_260_125_msg0022
rows.name: Metamorph Orb!

rows.label: fev04_260_125_msg0023
rows.name: Photon Circle!

rows.label: fev04_260_125_msg0024
rows.name: Fairy-Tale Belt Pulley!

rows.label: fev04_260_125_msg0025
rows.name: Arc Indicator!

rows.label: fev04_260_125_msg0026
rows.name: Insect Chip!

rows.label: fev04_260_125_msg0027
rows.name: Perfect Range Sensor!

rows.label: fev04_260_125_msg0028
rows.name: Bion Connector!

rows.label: fev04_260_125_msg0029
rows.name: Wait, wait, wait!

rows.label: fev04_260_125_msg0030
rows.name:
Nobody's gonna be able
to remember all that!

rows.label: fev04_260_125_msg0031
rows.name:
I haven't even gotten through
one-thirtieth of the list yet, mo...

rows.label: fev04_260_125_msg0032
rows.name:
But I did recognize one of those
names...

rows.label: fev04_260_125_msg0033
rows.name:
Didn't you say that Bion Connector
was easy to salvage around Gula?

rows.label: fev04_260_125_msg0034
rows.name:
Actually, you can only get it in Gula
right now, mo.

rows.label: fev04_260_125_msg0035
rows.name:
So whoever built Kiku would
have to import those parts
from Gula, right?

rows.label: fev04_260_125_msg0036
rows.name: We might find a lead at Port Ananyam.

rows.label: fev04_260_125_msg0037
rows.name:
We don't have much else to
go on, so it's worth a try.
